standard_prerequisites.name: Images under the simplicial operators
standard_prerequisites.use: U'_m = sum of the images Im(U(phi)) over phi : [m] -> [i] with i <= n; the claimed sub simplicial object agrees with U in degrees <= n.

standard_prerequisites.name: The splitting of simplicial objects in abelian categories
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 2332-2340: U is split, so it suffices to test the intersection with the normalized subobject against the sum of images of the N(U_{m'}).

core_obligations: U' is a simplicial subobject (proof lines 2323-2330): the image of Im(U(phi)) under U(psi) for psi : [m'] -> [m] equals Im(U(phi psi)) with phi psi : [m'] -> [i], so the U'_m are stable under the simplicial operators; U'_i = U_i for i <= n by the identity map.

Vanishing of the normalized part (lines 2330-2352): for m > n, N(U'_m) = U'_m intersect N(U_m); by the splitting lemma it suffices to show U'_m is contained in the sum of Im(U(phi)|_{N(U_{m'})}) over surjective phi : [m] -> [m'], m' < m; by the splitting each U_{m'} is the sum of images of the N(U_{m''}) under degeneracies, so the displayed sum equals the sum of Im(U(phi)) over surjective phi : [m] -> [m'], m' < m; and any phi : [m] -> [i] with i <= n factors as [m] -> [m'] -> [i] with [m] -> [m'] surjective and m' < m (as m > n >= i), whence the containment.
proof_roadmap: Check stability of the images under the simplicial operators.
Reduce the normalized-intersection claim to the split sum over surjections.
Factor the defining maps through surjections to lower degrees to conclude.
difficulty_reason: Subobject lemma (statement 2309-2321, proof 2323-2352): the subobject generated by images of structure maps into degrees <= n is a simplicial subobject agreeing with U up to n and with zero normalized part above n - stability is one line, the vanishing uses the splitting lemma (card L46157) and a factorization of the defining maps; no verification is omitted. H2: structural bookkeeping over the splitting.
